raw_input: Bikin konten feed untuk promo cold brew bulan ini, target anak muda kantoran di Solo.
core_message: The new cold brew is made for the middle of a working afternoon, not for a special occasion.

audience.description: Office workers aged 24 to 34 in a mid-sized Javanese city who buy coffee two or three times a week and judge it on taste and price together.

mandatories: Show the cold brew in the reusable bottle
